description: For every gi sponsor whose consent is not yes, generate a ready-to-send draft asking for (1) written permission to embroider their mark on the gi and (2) the vector logo. Does NOT send (outbound mail is a human gate). When a brand grants permission, record it with mu_gi_logo_set consent:yes. Owner-only.
name: mu_gi_request_logos
title: Draft logo-permission request emails for the gi (owner only)
